title: docs(skills, spec): the ui and i18n skills teach an action's refusals catalogue and its translation keys; action.zod.ts gains a module description
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
Fixes #34824
Clause-②: no — skill teaching text, evals and two comment-only edits in packages/spec; no schema, export or accept set moves
Metadata-protocol: none — no metadata key is touched
Tier: H — `check-governed-merges --branch` at ce9156c34c: four `skills/**` paths govern the PR. The low-risk skills arm does not fit this diff, which also carries `packages/spec` comments, a token-ceiling row and a changeset that releases `@objectstack/spec`
Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:已发布技能 `objectstack-ui` 的 `rules/actions.md` 新增一小节,教脚本动作怎样声明拒绝语目录 `refusals`、在动作体里只抛代码;`objectstack-i18n` 的对象键表新增一行,给出动作拒绝语的翻译键(`objects.OBJ._actions.ACT.refusals.CODE.message`、`.reasons.REASON.message`,无对象的动作写在 `globalActions.ACT` 下),并说明这句话按调用者语言回出。两个技能各加一条评测用例。另有两处只改注释的 spec 改动:`action.zod.ts` 加了模块说明(生成的参考页和两个技能索引行改为显示这句说明),`actionRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody` 上方的注释改成与函数实际判断一致。
- 为什么改:PR #34719 已经让动作体可以按调用者的语言拒绝,但技能没有教。照技能写应用的 agent 仍会写 `throw new Error('英文句子')`,中文用户在失败提示里看到的还是英文。
- 风险与回滚:不动任何 schema、导出和运行时行为,spec 只改注释。`rules/actions.md` 的 token 上限行由 2808 调到 2982:先删掉同文件 26 字节的重复,余下 174 按实测上调。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 中 `rules/actions.md` 那一行和它上方的注释(上限上调,风险最高);② `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 的新小节 "Refusing by code (`refusals`)" 与 Add Line 示例里改动的两行;③ `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 键表末尾新增的一行。
- 两分钟验证:运行 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md is 2982 tokens (ceiling 2982; headroom 0)` 和 `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md is 6305 tokens (ceiling 6333; headroom 28)`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:审批本 PR(Tier H:改了 `skills/**`,并带 spec 注释和 token 上限行,不适用低风险 skills 通道);落地由席位完成。

## What changes

Placeholders are spelled as words in this body (`OBJ`, `ACT`, `CODE`, `REASON`, `HOOK`); the files keep their own placeholder spelling.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`** (the declaration)

- New subsection "Refusing by code (`refusals`)", under the action body context. It says: `throw new Error('…')` answers every caller in the author's language; a `type: 'script'` action with a `js` body declares `refusals` and throws the code (an inline `target` function is lowered to a `js` body, and any other action is refused the key); the catalogue, the throws and the checks are a hook's, taught in objectstack-data (Lifecycle Hooks, "Declared refusals") and only pointed at here; the sentence is answered as `userMessage` and translated at `objects.OBJ._actions.ACT.refusals.CODE.message`; the console's failure toast shows it unless the action authors `errorMessage`.
- The Add Line example declares `refusals: { PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: { message: 'Product not found.', status: 404 } }` and throws `{ code: 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND' }` where it threw `new Error('Product not found.')`. The block is `os:check`-marked, so `check:skill-examples` type-checks it.

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`** (the translation keys and the localized answer)

- Object key table, one new row: `_actions.{action_name}.refusals.{CODE}` holds `message`, and `reasons.{reason}.message` per declared reason; a key for a code or reason the action does not declare is `translation-target-unknown`; the same keys sit under `globalActions.{action_name}`.
- "Server-composed text" section, the app-authored bullet: an action's refusal is named beside a hook's. Both are served in the caller's locale, negotiated over the locales the app's translations hold, else as declared, with no `en` floor.

**Evals** (one case in each touched skill's existing file)

- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, case 20: a script action that refuses with an English `throw new Error(…)`; the prompt asks for a refusal in the caller's language with code `NOT_DRAFT` and a 409. Required: `refusals`, `NOT_DRAFT`, `409`, `_actions`. Forbidden: `hooks.submit_signoff`.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`, case 13: an action that declares two refusals, one with a reason and a `{{ stage }}` hole; the prompt asks which bundle keys translate them and what a locale no bundle covers gets. Required: `_actions`, `submit_signoff`, `refusals`, `NOT_DRAFT`, `reasons`, `closed`. Forbidden: `hooks.submit_signoff`.
- Every token is layout-free: a key or code name, never a spaced or quoted fragment, so an answer written as a dotted key and one written as a nested object both pass (probes under Tests).

**`packages/spec`, comments only**

- N4: `src/ui/action.zod.ts` opens with a module doc block. Its first line is "Action protocol schemas — `ActionSchema`, the `action` metadata type, and the parts it is built from."
- N5: the jsdoc above `actionRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody` (`src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`) names the third case as the function judges it: a `script` action with no `body`, which is what a string `target` naming a host handler, or an inline `target` function `os build` could not lower, leaves.

**Generated, never hand-edited** (`check:generated --fix`, which ran `gen:skill-refs` and `gen:docs`)

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md` and `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md`: the `action.zod.ts` row prints the module description where it listed the first five exports. `check-governed-merges` recomputes both and reads them byte-equal to `gen:skill-refs` on this tree.
- `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`: the page description and lead are the doc block.

**`.changeset/34824-action-refusals-skill.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch and `@objectstack/spec` patch, with both declaration lines.

### Token ratchet: cuts first, then the measured remainder

Raise path: the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068).

| File | Cut (same file) | Text that still carries it |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | The label line "**Script-typed action**:" above the Add to Campaign example (26 bytes with its blank line) | The block's own `type: 'script'` line, under the H2 "Examples" |
| `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` | The path prefix in "Full Zod shape: `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` — …", now "(`translation.zod.ts`)" (44 bytes) | The full path at lines 206 and 267 of the same file, and `references/_index.md` |
| `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` | The hook reason key's repeated prefix `hooks.HOOK.refusals`, now `….CODE.reasons.REASON.message` (18 bytes) | The full hook key earlier in the same sentence |

- `rules/actions.md` had zero headroom. The text adds 721 bytes and the cut removes 26: 11231 to 11926 bytes, `ceil(11926 / 4)` = 2982. The row moves 2808 to 2982 (+174), the measured remainder, pinned at the measurement. Two reads of the file found no other passage that restates another; the earlier rows of this file (in the script's comments) spent the rest.
- `objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` needs no row move: 6219 to 6305 tokens against the ceiling 6333. The table row adds 322 bytes, the bullet a net 68 after its 18-byte key cut, and the path cut removes 44: 24894 to 25240 bytes.

### Size readings (`skills/**`)

| | Before (origin/main 1282a464e9) | After (ce9156c34c) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, lines | 224 | 233 |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, tokens (ceiling 2808, now 2982) | 2808 | 2982 |
| `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, lines | 533 | 534 |
| `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, tokens (ceiling 6333) | 6219 | 6305 |
| All `SKILL.md` under `skills/`, lines | 4729 | 4730 |
| Bundle total, tokens (whole shipped tree) | 262296 | 263279 |

The bundle moves +983 tokens: +174 in `rules/actions.md`, +86 in the i18n SKILL.md, +324 and +397 in the two eval fixtures (measured, not priced) and +1 in each generated index.

## Tests

- No runtime behaviour changes and the spec edits are comments, so there is no new unit test and no ablation.
- Eval assertions, by script over both files (12 and 20 cases): every `must_contain` string is in its `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` string is, the ids are distinct. 0 violations. Control leg: a copy with an absent required token, a present forbidden token and a duplicated id reports all three and exits 1.
- The two new cases against six probe answers, graded by the runner's own `gradeAnswer` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts`): a right answer written as code across lines with a nested bundle object passes each case; a locale branch in the body, the hook key, and a `messages` entry each fail. 6 of 6 as expected.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --dry-run`: exit 0, the catalog loads with no refusal (`objectstack-i18n: 19 case(s)`, `objectstack-ui: 40 case(s)`). `--self-test`: `30 rows pass`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` under the verify lock, at 2a2e7d6660: `Test Files 852 passed (852)`, `Tests 27264 passed | 1 todo (27265)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The i18n token row is shared with two open drafts.** Alone this branch reads 6305 of 6333. Merged locally with #35031 (ef6d08ce1f) the file reads 6342 tokens; with #34970 (8f62dd835c), 6369; with both, 6406. Each merge is textually clean and the eval ids stay distinct (1 to 13). Whichever of the three lands after the first goes red on that row and re-pays it there, as the claim says.
- **Two drafts opened after this branch was pushed conflict with it textually** (`overlap-check` exit 1). #35077 (32fa1759a0) rewrites the same `rules/actions.md` row in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`; the skill file itself merges cleanly, and the merged file measures 12821 bytes, 3206 tokens, which is the number the second lander pins. #35085 (7d7241a893) regenerates `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`; the second lander re-runs `check:generated --fix`. Its edits to `action.zod.ts` and `hook-refusal-codes.ts` merge cleanly with the two comments here. The landing order is the seat's.
- The i18n eval case is numbered 13 and sits before case 10, so its hunk stays apart from #35031's case 12 at the end of the list.
- The objectstack-ui `SKILL.md` router line for `rules/actions.md` does not name `refusals`. That file has zero headroom and is outside this card's file surface. Noted, not filed.
- The teaching points at objectstack-data's "Declared refusals" for the entry shape (`status`, `params`, `reasons`) and does not restate it. An agent holding the ui bundle alone gets the declaration, the throw and the key from the subsection and the example.
- `origin/main` was merged twice while this work ran (357fb1ea45, then 1282a464e9, which carries the eval reader of #35022). No conflict either time; the generated files were not touched by either merge.

## Verification

<details><summary>Premise, re-measured on origin/main</summary>

- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` ("Refuse in the user's language — `refusals`") and `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` (the "Action refusal messages" row) document what the skills now teach.
- One resolver answers a hook's and an action's catalogue (`resolveSandboxedRefusal`, `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`), so "the catalogue, the throws and the checks are a hook's" holds.
- `checkActionRefusals` (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`) reports `translation-target-unknown` for an undeclared code and for an undeclared reason.
- The console shows an authored `errorMessage` first, then the refusal's `userMessage` (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`).
- `refuseUndeclaredLiteralActionRefusalCode` (`action.zod.ts`) calls `actionRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody` when the type is not `script` or `body.language` is not `js`; with no body the language is undefined, the third arm of the sentence.
</details>

A later `origin/main` (36d46b5323) also merges cleanly and touches none of this PR's files; it was not merged in.
